---
title: "SuRGE chem vs NLA chem"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Background

Quick comparison of selected analytes measured during SuRGE and the two most recent NLA campaigns (NLA17 and NLA22).

## Data

Required data are created via the `targets` pipeline. Load data here.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(targets)
library(plotly)
tar_load(dat_raw)
```

## Plots

```{r}
#| echo: false
{dat_raw %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla22_sulfate, so4_shallow, 
      text = paste("SuRGE:", so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA 22:", nla22_sulfate, "<br>",
                   "nla22_site_id:", nla22_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id)
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    ggtitle("NLA 2022") +
    xlab("NLA22 SO4") +
    ylab("SuRGE SO4")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")

{dat_raw %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      nla17_sulfate, so4_shallow,
      text = paste("SuRGE:", so4_shallow, "<br>",
                   "NLA 17:", nla17_sulfate, "<br>",
                   "nla17_site_id:", nla17_site_id, "<br>",
                   "SuRGE lake_id:", lake_id)
    )
    ) +
    geom_point() +
    ggtitle("NLA 2017") +
    xlab("NLA17 SO4") +
    ylab("SuRGE SO4")} %>%
  ggplotly(tooltip = "text")
```
